conflictBody: Someone else saved this server while you had it open, so nothing here was written. Reload to pick up their changes, then make yours again.
connectUnconfigured: Discord connect is not configured on this deployment.
connectedLivedIn: Bagel joined. This server already has a layout, so it was not rebuilt. Bagel adopted the channels it recognised; pick the rest below.
degraded: Could not reach the backend. Try again in a moment.
description: Connect a Discord server or create one from Bagel’s template. Go-live, clips, welcomes, tickets, temporary voice, staff logs, and crumb ranks, all from one bot.
emptyBody: Add Bagel to a Discord server you own, or build one from our template first. You can connect as many servers as you like.
layoutUnavailable: Could not list your server’s channels and roles, so the pickers are turned off. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.
invalidFieldBanner: {field} was not valid, so it kept the value it already had. It is marked below.
fieldInvalid: Not valid, so this kept the value it already had.
reauthNeeded: This server was added before Bagel asked for the Change Nickname permission, so the premium name cannot be applied here. The premium avatar still works. Re-authorize to finish it.
serversHelp: Each server keeps its own channels, roles and settings. Open one to change it.
serversTruncated: Showing the first {n} servers. You have connected more than this list can show.
unsavedBody: You changed settings on this page and have not saved them yet.
savedChannelBlocked: Bagel can no longer post in the saved channel. Give it Send Messages there, or pick another channel.
